news.analysis: Tracy suffered an injury during the Giants' win over the Houston Texans, a game in which he carried the ball six times for 15 yards and a score. The third-year running back had seen an uptick in snaps after playing 3% or fewer in the opening three weeks, scoring three touchdowns in the last two weeks. Cam Skattebo and Devin Singletary will lead the way for a New York running back room that bounced back in Week 7. Tracy is eligible to return in Week 13, given New York's Week 8 bye.

news.contents: The New York Giants are placing running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) on Injured Reserve after he exited the team's Week 7 overtime win over the Texans with a hamstring injury. One week after being held without a touch as an unofficial punishment for his fumbling issues, second-year back Cam Skattebo ran for a career-high 124 yards, but also tweaked his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime.
